modules.module_title: Assist in preparing the coffee seeds

pcs.pc_description: assist in selecting healthy and mature seed bearer plants for extracting coffee seeds
check the moisture percentage using a moisture meter, and harvest fully-developed and ripe berries from the seed bearers
remove the berry floats and pulp manually or mechanically as per the supervisor’s instructions, ensuring hygiene to prevent contamination
sieve the berries, mix them with sieved wood ash and dry under shade
grade the seeds as per the supervisor’s instructions and remove all cut, triangular and elephant beans
assist in treating the seeds with the recommended organomercurial fungicide to prevent fungal infection and store them at the recommended temperature in hygienic conditions

modules.module_title: Assist in raising saplings in the nursery

pcs.pc_description: co-ordinate with an approved laboratory to detect the presence of nematodes in the soil
apply the treatment recommended by the lab to remove nematodes from the soil
carry out soil solarisation as per the supervisor’s instructions
assist in selecting the appropriate organic method for the cultivation of coffee saplings in the nursery
assist in preparing a raised nursery bed or a polybag bed for raising saplings, ensuring the soil is loamy and has the required organic matters such as farmyard manure or compost
mix the recommended quantity of coarse sand in the soil as per the supervisor’s instructions, to ensure effective drainage and aeration
arrange for quality water to irrigate the nursery bed and shading to protect it from direct sunlight
sow the coffee seeds at the recommended depth and density to ensure their healthy growth
follow the recommended practices to protect the saplings from pests, diseases and fluctuations in temperature
harvest and acclimatise the coffee saplings at the recommended temperature for the appropriate duration
store the harvested saplings at the recommended temperature and humidity before being transplanted

modules.module_title: Assist in preparing the field for transplantation

pcs.pc_description: remove any debris, waste materials and weeds from the field
assist in preparing the field for easy movement of relevant farm machineries
• carry out ploughing and harrowing in the field using the appropriate farm machineries and implements, as per the supervisor’s instructions to • achieve the recommended tilth

apply the recommended fertilisers in an appropriate quantity to supplement the required macro and micronutrients, ensuring the saplings are planted after the recommended duration to allow nutrients to get absorbed into the soil
carry out liming of the field soil as per the supervisor’s instructions to achieve the required pH levels
assist in installing an appropriate irrigation or fertigation system
create drainage conduits as per the supervisor’s instructions, maintaining the optimum space
drain out any stagnant water from the field to prevent rotting in the saplings
assist in arranging shading in the field to maintain the recommended temperature and soil moisture for the optimum growth of coffee crop
prepare pits in the field as per the supervisor’s instructions for transplanting coffee saplings
assist in transplanting the coffee saplings, maintaining the planting density recommended for the selected coffee variety and field’s topography
carry out staking to support the vertical growth of transplanted saplings
apply the recommended organic and inorganic fertilisers to the saplings as per the supervisor’s instructions
water the saplings with the recommended quantity
apply mulch around the roots of the saplings to preserve soil moisture and prevent the growth of weeds

modules.module_title: Assist in nutrient, pest and disease management

pcs.pc_description: sample the field soil, pack and label it, and assist in its testing via an approved laboratory to ensure the coffee crop receives the required macro and micronutrients
select the appropriate organic and inorganic fertilisers such as Farm Yard Manure (FYM) containing the required macro and micronutrients
apply fertilisers to coffee plants using foliar spray as per the fertilisation schedule recommended for the coffee variety, and the supervisor’s instructions
adopt relevant cultural practices to enhance the percentage of soil nutrients for the benefit of coffee plants
check the coffee crop regularly to identify the signs of pest and disease infestation
apply the recommended treatment as per the Integrated Pest and Disease Management (IPDM) practices and supervisor’s instructions
assist in carrying out intercropping to promote the healthy growth of coffee plants

modules.module_title: Assist in weeding, pruning and training

pcs.pc_description: carry out mulching as per the supervisor’s instructions to prevent the growth of weeds
carry out digging, forking and remove weeds from the field as per the supervisor’s instructions
apply the recommended herbicides and weedicides as per instructions
carry out pruning of the coffee plants to remove dead and infested leaves and branches
train the coffee plants to ensure their desired growth

carry out minor repair of machineries/equipment used in various plantation operations
use water and other resources optimally in various tasks and processes
plug water leakages to prevent its wastage
segregate waste into appropriate categories as per the supervisor’s instructions
assist in recycling and disposing waste appropriately

pcs.pc_description: check the maturity of cherries on coffee plants through co-ordination with the supervisor
prepare the relevant tools and equipment for harvesting cherries
assist in carrying out mechanical or manual harvesting of cherries, following the strip picking or selective picking method as per the supervisor’s instructions
ensure harvesting of mature cherries only and at appropriate intervals
collect the harvested cherries in appropriate bags or baskets, ensuring no damage to the cherries

modules.module_title: Assist in carrying out post-harvest management

pcs.pc_description: dry the harvested cherries under the sun or mechanically using a hot air dryer as per the supervisor’s instructions
carry out pulping of cherries to obtain the coffee beans and clean the beans as per instructions
sort the coffee beans on appropriate parameters
grade the coffee beans based on shape and size with the help of a rotating sieve
pack the coffee beans in air-tight packing, protecting them from moisture
apply the recommended treatment in the storage area to remove pest and insects
store the packed coffee beans in a dry and hygienic storage area
load the packed beans in the transport vehicle, protecting them and packing material from damage
assist the supervisor in maintaining the manual and/ or electronic record of coffee beans processed and transported, using the physical registers and/ or the relevant computer application
